svg.text: DronePhotographer MPC Planning: composition-driven camera optimization
Model Predictive Control loop that uses a trained Qwen-VL to iteratively optimize camera pose toward a target photographic composition.
High-level composition specs are compiled into margin-based score targets. Visualizations show target bbox placement in a 4:3 frame.
Presets without center/occupancy/aspect set direct bbox score keys (e.g., centered_50 sets
Custom targets via --target_json override or extend any preset.
Score weights via --score_weights_json (defaults: occupancy=2.0, centroid=2.0, others=1.0).
Dashed box = target bounding box placement. Subject silhouette is illustrative.
Candidates ranked by weighted error vs. target plus regularization.
Greedy per-step optimization: at each step, generate all candidate actions, batch-score with the VLM, select the best, and advance.
4. Example MPC rollout: subject repositioning toward centered_50 target
The camera moves over 16 steps so the subject (shown as a silhouette) progressively becomes centered at ~50% frame occupancy. The dashed green box is the target.
Uses pre-rendered view dataset as the action space.
After selecting best action, snaps to nearest existing view
Faster: no rendering, VLM scoring only.
Limitation: rollout quality depends on view coverage.
Parse failure penalty: 10.0 (heavily penalizes bad VLM outputs)
Re-renders actual Blender scene at each step.
Produces true camera movement through the 3D scene.
Optionally runs GroundingDINO for ground-truth scores.
Slower: full Blender render per step (~seconds each).
Accurate: real scene geometry and lighting.
Each scripts/infer_mpc_*.sh configures RUN_DIR, MODEL_PATH, score weights, and target JSON for a specific composition goal.
Override environment variables: CANDIDATE_BATCH_SIZE (default 96), INITIAL_SEED (default 721), SCORE_WEIGHTS_JSON
All scripts default to Qwen3.5-VL-2B checkpoint and Blender-in-the-loop mode with 16 planning steps.
Edge-placement scripts use custom score weights to prioritize margin targets over centroid_offset.
Tested with Qwen3.5-VL-2B (checkpoint-14000) on DogWalk scene. Results in runs/infer_mpc_blender/.
Subject reliably moved to frame center (centroid_offset ~ 0.01)
Occupancy ratio adjustable from ~5% to ~50% via target setting
Subject placed at intersection points with top_right_thirds preset
Typical target error: 0.54 -> 0.02 over 16 MPC steps
1.8:1 wide aspect compositions achieved with centered_wide presets
VLM approach significantly outperforms baseline at 60% training.
Training data only 2-8m; no close-range (0.5-2m) positions exist
Model cannot reason: "lower elevation + approach = upper body crop"
Setting 1:1 aspect target has minimal effect on camera behavior
2D bbox aspect ratio not strongly coupled to 3D camera movement
Learns: "move right -> bbox shifts left" (2D correlation)
Fix: add 3D-aware score keys + close-range data (P0)
1. 3D score keys: elevation, azimuth, distance, pitch
3. Subject text in VLM prompt (from GroundingDINO label)
